caption: The drawing depicts two views of a metallic object that resembles ornate scissors with an attached container, rendered in black and gray pencil on a cream-colored paper background. The top view shows the object from above, displaying two elaborately designed finger rings connected to slender, curving handles, which converge at a central pivot. One end of the object has two pointed, scalloped blades, with a decorative, oval medallion set into the rectangular central body between the handles and blades. The bottom view presents a side elevation of the same object, revealing a rectangular compartment with a curved lid, mounted atop a flat base that is supported by two knob-like legs; an additional horizontal bar extends from the base. The composition is centered within a lightly drawn rectangular border, and the objects are rendered with fine shading and line work to indicate texture and depth.
title: Snuffer
